input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Section 15 restricts assignment mutually with only an affiliate carve-out. It falls short of our preferred position in three respects: (i) Client has no carve-out to assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, so an acquisition of Mortgage Logic.com would require TrueLink's consent; (ii) the consent standard is unqualified rather than "not unreasonably withheld"; and (iii) nothing prevents TrueLink from assigning to a Client competitor. No change-of-control termination or re-pricing right exists elsewhere in the document (searches for "change of control", "merger" and "successor" returned nothing), so the redline adds a confirmatory statement that a Client ownership change is not a deemed assignment. The redline is a single in-place amendment to Section 15 reaching the preferred position; the mutual notice-based fallback is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Add successor/M&A carve-out for Client, reasonableness standard, and competitor bar on TrueLink assignments
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a carve-out so that we may assign without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and made TrueLink's assignments subject to our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and not to our competitors. Our playbook requires freedom to reorganize or be acquired without vendor consent; if helpful, we can accept a mutual notice-based successor right with consent not unreasonably withheld for other assignments.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed; provided, that no such approval shall be required for (a) an assignment by either party to a financially responsible affiliate or (b) an assignment by Client to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or equity. In no event shall TrueLink assign or transfer this Agreement to a competitor of Client. No change in the ownership or control of Client shall constitute an assignment hereunder or give rise to any right of TrueLink to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
